membership_note: counts are SAMPLE-MAP MEMBERSHIPS, not unique objects: the 30-degree patches overlap, so one object is a member of many maps

source_selection_digest.definition: SHA256 over sorted records (ObjID, population, center, magnitude_bin, physical_weight)
source_selection_digest.neo_identifier_note: NEO rows come from the NEOMOD3 GEN cache and carry no S3M ObjID; they are identified by an ordered orbital record (a,e,i,H,vlam,vbeta)
source_selection_digest.method: selection stage rerun independently once per density_mode; no map rebuilt
